doc:
games/steal-egg/art/fx/
  fx.json     {"doc": ..., "systems": {"<GameObject path>": {...}}, "textures": {...}, "materials": {...}, "stats": {...}}
  <name>-<hash8>.webp   every texture a particle material uses (RGBA kept; lossless up to 256 px)
  fx.glb      only if a system draws meshes (renderMode 4): the meshes, glTF mesh i = fx.json meshes[i]

One entry per ParticleSystem, keyed by the GameObject path ("Player4/Blood", "Env/.../Area_magic_multicolor");
a path that occurs twice gets "#<GameObject path id>". Fields (Unity names kept where short, units = Unity's):
  go, node      GameObject path id, index of the node with that path in art/world/scene.json (null if not exported)
  active        GameObject and all parents active (m_IsActive); "playOnAwake" is separate
  main          duration, loop, prewarm, delay, space (local|world|custom), speed (simulationSpeed), scaling
                (hierarchy|local|shape), maxParticles, gravity, startLifetime, startSpeed, startSize (or startSize3
                [x,y,z] when size3D), startRotation (radians, or startRotation3), startColor, flipRotation
  emission      rate (over time), rateDistance, bursts [{t, count, cycles, interval, prob}]
  shape         type (name), angle, radius, radiusThickness, arc, length, box, donut, pos, rot (degrees), scale,
                randomDir, sphericalDir, alignToDirection
  colorOverLifetime, sizeOverLifetime, rotationOverLifetime, velocityOverLifetime, forceOverLifetime, noise,
  limitVelocity, textureSheet, subEmitters   present only when the module is enabled
  renderer      mode (billboard|stretch|horizontal|vertical|mesh), material (key into "materials"), minSize, maxSize,
                lengthScale, velocityScale, sortingFudge, sortingOrder, alignment, pivot, flip
  unsupported   enabled modules this export does not describe (collision, trails, lights, ...)
Value encodings:
  MinMaxCurve  {"c": v} constant | {"r": [min, max]} random between constants | {"k": keys, "s": scalar} curve
               | {"k": keys, "k2": keys, "s": scalar} random between two curves; keys = [[time, value, inSlope,
               outSlope], ...] (value * s is the real value; time 0..1 over lifetime, or over the system duration)
  MinMaxGradient {"c": [r,g,b,a]} | {"c": a, "c2": b} random between colours | {"g": G} | {"g": G, "g2": G2} random
               between gradients | {"g": G, "rand": 1} random colour along G; G = {"c": [[t,r,g,b]], "a": [[t,a]],
               "fixed": 0|1}
prefabSystems: the same for the 69 systems inside resources.assets prefabs (brainrot / egg effects, keyed
"<prefab root>/<child path>"; "node" indexes art/brainrots/scene.json nodes when the path matches).
Materials: {"shader", "tex", "tint", "blend" (alpha|additive|premultiply|multiply|opaque), "cull", "softParticles",
"raw": the numeric properties}. Colours are Gamma space (project is Gamma), as stored.
